extraction_notes.visit_pattern: Weekly for the first 6 weeks (Days 1, 8, 15, 22, 29, 36, 43) for BP monitoring and baseline assessments, then every 6 weeks (Visit 10) for MRI and drug dispensing.
assumptions: Screening is counted as a single calendar day.
Arm A is excluded from the 3-weekly CBC visits (Visit 9) per footnote 'd' which links that frequency to Lomustine dosing.

Day 22 (Visit 5) includes labs and drug dispensing but no imaging, so it is categorized as 'labs'.
All other scheduled visits (Day 1, 43, 85, etc.) include MRI, so they are categorized as 'imaging_diagnostics'.

extraction_notes.visit_pattern: Weekly for the first 6 weeks (Cycle 1), then every 3 weeks (Visit 9) for CBC/BP, with Lomustine administration every 6 weeks (Visit 10).

Intermediate visits for CBC (Day 8, 15, 22, 29, 36, 64, 106, etc.) are categorized as 'labs'.

extraction_notes.visit_pattern: Weekly for the first 6 weeks (Cycle 1), then every 3 weeks (Visit 9) for CBC/BP, with Lomustine administration every 6 weeks (Visit 10).

extraction_notes.visit_pattern: Screening, Day 1 (Randomization/Dispensing), Month 6, Month 12
assumptions: Screening assessments (History, PE, Labs, Imaging) are assumed to be completed in a single calendar day.

The 6-month visit includes labs and clinical evaluation; it is categorized as 'labs' per priority rules.
The 12-month visit includes a mammogram, labs, and clinical evaluation; it is categorized as 'imaging_diagnostics' per priority rules.
Category priority applied: core_treatment > imaging_diagnostics > labs > clinic_visits.

extraction_notes.visit_pattern: Weeks 1, 6, 12, 17, 22, 26: 2 days of Doxo/Cis. Weeks 4, 5, 9, 10, 15, 16, 20, 21, 24, 25, 28, 29: 1 day of MTX + 1 day of Leucovorin/Labs. Weekly or twice-weekly labs throughout.
assumptions: Screening estimated at 2 days based on extensive baseline requirements in Section 7.1.
Surgery at Week 11 counted as 1 unique contact day.
Methotrexate (MTX) administration requires a follow-up day for Leucovorin rescue and lab monitoring.
Follow-up visits after treatment completion (Week 29) occur every 6 weeks to 3 months.

extraction_notes.visit_pattern: Same as MAP for first 29 weeks. Starting Week 30, weekly subcutaneous injections of Peg-IFN.
assumptions: Peg-IFN maintenance starts at Week 30 and occurs weekly.
Labs during maintenance are performed monthly but coincide with injection days (assigned to core_treatment).

extraction_notes.visit_pattern: Induction same as MAP. Post-op cycles 4, 6, 8 include 5 consecutive days of Ifosfamide/Etoposide. Cycles 5 and 9 include 3 consecutive days of Doxo/Ifos.
assumptions: MAPIE post-operative cycles are more intensive, requiring 3-5 consecutive days of infusion per cycle.
Labs are performed twice weekly following intensive chemotherapy blocks.

extraction_notes.visit_pattern: Day 1 of each 21-day cycle for treatment. Cycle 1 Day 8 for biomarker labs. ECHO/MUGA every 4 cycles (C2, C6, C10, C14) assumed combined with next cycle's Day 1 visit where possible. End of treatment visit 30 days after last dose. Survival follow-up every 3 months.
assumptions: Screening is estimated to take 2 days (one for imaging/diagnostics, one for labs/clinical).
ECHO/MUGA visits (C2, C6, C10) are assumed to be combined with the subsequent cycle's Day 1 treatment visit to minimize patient burden, as they are scheduled for the 'last week' of the cycle.
The C1D8 biomarker lab visit is included as it represents a scheduled healthcare contact.
The Month 12 follow-up visit includes a mammogram, categorizing it as imaging_diagnostics.
The End of Treatment (EOT) visit occurs approximately 30 days after the last dose (Cycle 14 Day 1).

extraction_notes.visit_pattern: 2 visits per 28-day cycle. One visit on Day 1 of each cycle for labs and assessments, and one visit for Pembrolizumab infusion every 21 days (Q3W).
assumptions: Assumed 1 unique calendar day for screening based on Visit 1 requirements.
Pembrolizumab infusions (Q3W) and Cycle Day 1 visits (Q4W) were mapped to unique calendar days over 12 months.
Infusion days are categorized as core_treatment; non-infusion Day 1 visits are categorized as labs due to myeloma laboratory testing requirements.
Screening is categorized as imaging_diagnostics due to required skeletal surveys and MRI/CT/PET scans.

extraction_notes.visit_pattern: 1 visit per 28-day cycle on Day 1 for labs, assessments, and drug dispensing.
assumptions: Assumed 1 unique calendar day for screening.
Control arm medications (Lenalidomide and Dexamethasone) are oral and taken at home, so clinic visits are categorized as labs due to the priority of myeloma laboratory testing performed every cycle.
Screening is categorized as imaging_diagnostics due to baseline skeletal and soft tissue imaging requirements.

extraction_notes.visit_pattern: AC every 3 weeks (4 cycles) followed by weekly Paclitaxel (12 doses)
assumptions: Used the AC -> WP regimen as the representative intensive path for Arm 1.
Screening assumed as 2 unique calendar days for consult/consent and battery of imaging/labs.
The 4-week post-chemotherapy visit (Day 190) is counted in the 9-month window as a clinic visit.
The 12-month visit (Day 365) includes imaging (ECHO/MUGA) and is counted as a separate diagnostic day.

arms.arm_name: Arm 2 (Chemotherapy plus Trastuzumab - AC -> WP + H regimen)

extraction_notes.visit_pattern: AC every 3 weeks (4 cycles), then weekly Paclitaxel + Trastuzumab (12 doses), then Trastuzumab every 3 weeks
assumptions: Used the AC -> WP + H regimen as the representative intensive path for Arm 2.
Screening assumed as 2 unique calendar days.
Maintenance Trastuzumab doses (every 3 weeks) are counted as core_treatment days.
The 12-month visit (Day 365) is counted as a separate imaging/diagnostic day as it falls between maintenance doses.

extraction_notes.visit_pattern: Cycles 1-2: Days 1, 8, 15, 22; Cycles 3-6: Days 1, 15; Cycles 7+: Day 1.
assumptions: Screening is assumed to take 1 unique calendar day for all assessments.
Patient is assumed to remain on treatment for the full 12-month period.
All clinic visits for the DaraPomDex arm include drug administration (IV or SC), thus categorized as core_treatment.

extraction_notes.visit_pattern: Cycles 1-2: Days 1, 8, 15, 22; Cycles 3-6: Days 1, 15; Cycles 7+: Day 1.
assumptions: The Schedule of Events (Table 7.3) indicates monitoring visits (vitals, labs) occur on the same schedule for both arms to ensure consistent safety oversight.
Since Pomalidomide and Dexamethasone are administered orally, clinic visits are primarily for laboratory monitoring and clinical assessment.
Screening is assumed to take 1 unique calendar day.

extraction_notes.visit_pattern: Radiation Phase: Daily (5 days/week) for 6 weeks. Maintenance: 3 days per cycle (Regimen A: Days 1, 8, 15; Regimen B: Days 1, 2, 8).
assumptions: Screening/Diagnosis workup is estimated at 2 days (one for imaging/audiogram, one for labs/CSF/GFR).
Radiation therapy consists of 30 fractions delivered 5 days per week over 6 weeks.
Maintenance chemotherapy starts at Week 11 (Day 71) following a 4-week rest period.
Month 1 (Day 30) includes 4 weeks of RT (20 days) plus the first 2 days of Week 5.
Month 3 (Day 90) includes the full 30 days of RT plus the first 3 visits of Maintenance Cycle 1.
Maintenance cycles alternate between Regimen A (6 weeks) and Regimen B (4 weeks).

extraction_notes.visit_pattern: Radiation Phase: Daily (5 days/week) for 6 weeks. Maintenance: 3 days per cycle (Regimen A: Days 1, 8, 15; Regimen B: Days 1, 2, 8).
assumptions: Reduced-dose CSRT arm receives the same total number of radiation fractions (30) as the standard arm, but with a lower craniospinal dose and higher boost components to reach the same cumulative dose (54 Gy).

extraction_notes.visit_pattern: C1D1, C2D1, then Day 1 of Cycles 3, 6, 9, 12, 15, 18, 21, 24.
assumptions: Screening consists of one baseline visit (Visit 0).

Cycle Day 1 visits are categorized as core_treatment because they involve the dispensing and compliance monitoring of the standard adjuvant endocrine therapy.
The 1-month window (Day 1-30) includes C1D1 and C2D1 (Day 29).

extraction_notes.visit_pattern: Days 1, 4, 8, 11 for RVD cycles; Day 1 for Maintenance cycles.
assumptions: Screening assessments estimated to take 2 unique calendar days (one for imaging/diagnostics, one for labs).
PBSC mobilization and collection estimated to take 4 unique calendar days (1 for cyclophosphamide, 3 for monitoring/collection).
Maintenance therapy (Lenalidomide) follows a 28-day cycle with additional lab visits as per footnote 3 (weekly for first 2 months, bi-weekly for next 2 months, monthly thereafter).
Arm A receives 8 cycles of RVD followed by maintenance.

extraction_notes.visit_pattern: Days 1, 4, 8, 11 for RVD cycles; Day 1 for Maintenance cycles; Inpatient stay for PBSCT.
assumptions: Screening assessments estimated to take 2 unique calendar days.
PBSC mobilization and collection estimated to take 4 unique calendar days.
PBSCT inpatient stay estimated at 21 unique calendar days of healthcare contact.

Arm B receives 3 initial RVD cycles, PBSCT, 2 consolidation RVD cycles, then maintenance.

extraction_notes.visit_pattern: Cycle 1: Days 1, 8, 15; Cycle 2+: Day 1 only.
assumptions: Screening is split into 3 unique days: Tissue Screening (labs), Main Screening Visit 1 (imaging/consent), and Main Screening Visit 2 (labs).

extraction_notes.visit_pattern: Screening (Info Visit, Visit 0), Randomization (Visit 1), then every 6 months (Visit 2, Visit 3).
assumptions: The Information Visit and Visit 0 are counted as two separate screening contact days.
Visit 1 is the start of the monitoring period (Day 1).
Visit 1 is assigned to 'labs' priority due to the venipuncture for CD4 and viral load required at baseline.
Subsequent 6-month visits (Visit 2, Visit 3) are assigned to 'labs' priority due to serum and swab collection for the biorepository.

extraction_notes.visit_pattern: Screening (Info Visit, Visit 0), Randomization/Treatment Start (Visit 1), Interim Treatment (Visit 1A, 1B, 1C), then every 6 months (Visit 2, Visit 3).
assumptions: Used the 85% Trichloroacetic Acid (TCA) treatment schedule as the representative for the Treatment Arm as it has the highest frequency of visits in the first year.

Subsequent 6-month visits (Visit 2, Visit 3) are assigned to 'labs' priority due to serum and swab collection for the biorepository.

extraction_notes.visit_pattern: Neoadjuvant: Cycles 1-4 (Q2W), Cycles 5-8 (Q3W with weekly Paclitaxel). Adjuvant: Cycles 9-22 (Q3W).
assumptions: Screening is estimated at 3 unique days (1 for labs/vitals, 1 for imaging/biopsy, 1 for surgical consultation).
Neoadjuvant phase (Cycles 1-8) lasts 140 days.
Surgery is assumed to occur 4 weeks after the last neoadjuvant dose (Day 154).
Adjuvant phase starts 2 weeks post-surgery (Day 168).
Paclitaxel weekly administration in Cycles 5-8 adds 2 extra visit days per cycle (Days 8 and 15) beyond the Day 1 cycle start.
Imaging (ECHO/ECG) and labs during treatment occur on the same day as drug administration and are categorized as core_treatment.

Screening is counted as 1 unique calendar day and categorized as imaging_diagnostics due to baseline CT/MRI.

extraction_notes.visit_pattern: 1 infusion visit every 3 weeks (21 days) for a total of 18 infusions.

Time windows (1_month, 3_months, etc.) are calculated from Day 1 (first infusion) and do not include screening visits.

extraction_notes.visit_pattern: Every 2 weeks (Q2W) for 1 year (W1, W3, W5... W49).

extraction_notes.visit_pattern: Day 1 of each 14-day cycle for 12 cycles, plus an End of Treatment (EOT) visit 14 days after the start of the final cycle.

extraction_notes.visit_pattern: Days 1, 2, 3, and 8 of each 21-day cycle for chemotherapy; daily for 14 fractions of radiation therapy (ISRT) post-chemotherapy.
assumptions: Screening assessments are completed over 2 unique calendar days.
G-CSF (Filgrastim/Pegfilgrastim) is administered at home and does not count as a healthcare contact day.
Interim response assessment (PET2/CT2) occurs on a single unique day between Cycles 2 and 3.
End of treatment assessment (PET5/CT) occurs on a single unique day post-chemotherapy.
All high-risk patients receive the protocol-specified 14 fractions of ISRT (daily contact for ~3 weeks).
